_comment: Chapter 1 teaches a single machine, so this lab gets no network interface at all —
the strongest isolation available, and the right default for a lab that does not need
to talk to anything. Chapter 2's network-basic lab will declare network: lab instead.
This manifest can only describe what the lab needs. It cannot ask for privileged mode,
capabilities, a host mount or a writable root: those are constants in
apps/lab-manager/src/sandbox-spec.ts and nothing in content can reach them.
